purpose: Reduce the user's Agent-learning and orchestration burden by giving an Agent a bounded, observable loop for intent, capability choice, lifecycle control, continuity, verification, and cleanup while preserving human authority over goals, judgment, trust, cost, and irreversible effects.
successDefinition: A user can state a real goal and corrections while the Harness keeps the active outcome, capability route, authority boundary, lifecycle state, evidence, handoff, and cleanup coherent with fewer user orchestration interventions than an ad-hoc path.
fixedInvariants: product outcomes outrank artifact counts, test counts, inventory counts, and research volume
one release has one explicit finite acceptance expression
guardrails constrain delivery but never count as product progress
every active work item maps to at least one release criterion
only one causal increment may be active
external capability expansion follows an evidenced gap and bounded authority
portfolio sufficiency is judged by demand coverage rather than by minimizing capability count
bounded inactive portfolio curation may investigate coverage without granting activation authority
historical evidence cannot become current authority by remaining on disk
unsupported host behavior is reported rather than simulated
adaptiveSurfaces: native, official, reviewed external, composed, or authored capability choice
delivery order inside the active causal increment

replanWhen: new evidence changes the critical path
the increment reaches its stop condition

bootstrapGuards: code-owned predecessor plan and acceptance path rejection

legacyEvidenceBoundary.role: inactive historical evidence reachable through repository history or explicitly legacy files
